meta.name: box-optimization
meta.description: Analyze packaging configurations for carton size selection, void fill minimization, palletization efficiency, sustainable materials, and total packaging cost reduction aligned with ISTA and ASTM D4169 standards. USE THIS SKILL WHEN: user mentions packaging optimization, box sizing, carton selection, void fill, DIM weight, palletization, shipping cost from packaging, ISTA testing, right-sizing boxes, or sustainable packaging materials. Trigger phrases: "optimize packaging", "reduce shipping cost from box size", "right-size boxes", "void fill analysis", "DIM weight savings", "pallet cube utilization", "packaging sustainability audit", "carton selection algorithm", "box-on-demand ROI".
